_comment: Rule-based TTS tone styling (no LLM). Applied AFTER _build_tts_text() produces the neutral base sentence. Each tone is an ORDERED list of {find, replace} substring rules applied in sequence via str.replace; 'neutral' applies no rules (base sentence returned unchanged) so existing tts_text assertions keep passing.
